author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before drew a tulip-like cup on top and two rounded hexagon boxes at the sides (read as a flower between two 'D' shapes); redrawn after the reference as a cilantro sprig: a stem with a pointed three-lobed top leaf and two jagged three-lobed side leaves growing from one node.
omissions: Rounded lobe scallops simplified to pointed straight-edged lobes; side leaves attach at the stem node instead of on branches (branches pushed the leaves narrower than 8 units).
